hypothesis: H10: совместная оценка скорости и возмущения

mechanism.prediction: Keep the existing causal mean motion prediction. Propagate a 2x2 first-order covariance including the current-step drive/resistance velocity derivative and v-d coupling. Add integrated disturbance random-walk Q plus existing velocity process noise.
mechanism.correction: One robust velocity innovation and H=[1,0], existing correlated-pair R (no 1/N reduction). Joint gain only when the existing two-new-wheel adaptation eligibility predicates pass. Otherwise Kd=0 with the full Joseph covariance update (Schmidt-style nuisance state), not an independent scalar reset.
mechanism.guards: Keep timestamp, stale, range, rate, disagreement, innovation cap, bootstrap, zero-lock, stop and bounded reacquisition predicates/thresholds. Keep disturbance constant during missing/untrusted data; do not repeat rejected v6 mean-decay.
mechanism.bounds: Retain v and d limits; bound covariance using a PSD-preserving diagonal scaling. On constrained d projection remove cross-covariance rather than retain an inconsistent correlation. Clear cross-covariance on bootstrap, confirmed stop and bounded reacquisition.
mechanism.runtime: Only controller/front/rear. No future samples, no new delay, unchanged Timeline and 20 Hz. Constant state and memory, stdlib math only. Actuator-state uncertainty is not jointly estimated; covariance is an approximation, not a calibrated confidence interval.

parameter_selection: No numerical fitting or search. The single variant is fixed here; train runs diagnose implementation/runtime only, and cannot change its parameters. Any later algorithm revision requires a separately declared hypothesis, not this validation round.

data_policy.train: Existing Store.load(bag, 'train'); controller/front/rear only. Do not read train GNSS. Train without reference cannot establish accuracy gains.
data_policy.validation: Freeze candidate source/patch, config and evaluator hashes after implementation checks and before the first validation bag is opened. One pass of all existing validation bags; reused validation, not independent final test.
data_policy.test: Never call FinalStore or authorize final test. Do not open or recompute final-test measurements, or attribute historical final metrics to H10.
data_policy.evaluator: Unmodified tools/finalization/evaluate.py score/replay/match/metrics and unmodified tools/research_v6/compare.py aggregation. Identical event arrays, timestamps, reference masks, 20 Hz, zero delay and original fault anchor/windows for baseline and candidate.
data_policy.faults: Published v6 anchor and bias 5s, dropout 5s, dropout 10s, lock 3s. No scenario replacement.

falsification: Reject this variant on any acceptance-gate violation, even if another metric improves. No eligible accuracy gain means no promotion. Missing real recordings/evaluation/runtime evidence means insufficient data, not a positive result. Unit and synthetic tests are implementation evidence only.
publication: Russian draft PR, never merge/auto-merge. All substantial regressions, per-bag raw measurements and limits retained. New reports only under reports/research_parallel/H10; immutable run_id/run_attempt checkpoint branches include H10.
